SexSlaveCraft 2.4.6 (TieJin Modify) 个人能力与浪漫控制；整合2.4.5身体开发。新增功能仅限RimWorld 1.7，1.6／Common保留SSC 2.4.1冻结基线。 五项个人能力开关保留原载体和规则；分阶段浪漫控制、对象多选、一次点名命令、综合心情与历史、日志／任务反馈及个人恢复默认。 继承子宫／生育控制与胃部开发，完善四语文案和PNA产出引导。保留文化、仪式演化点、医美、关系概览、九把PNA武器、凝胶外观、六特化和人格转移。 机制及简中文案已有分批实机认可；繁英俄文案已审阅，三语实机显示与PNA引导显示仍待确认，不补记全部模组组合或平衡结论。 升级时完整替换旧模组目录，保留版本目录与LoadFolders.xml。1.7旧简易PNA发射器及相关定义已移除，不提供引用旧定义的存档迁移。 Harmony与RJW先于SSC加载；文化及仪式需要Ideology。兔入口与旧RimTalk对接仍不可用。
Version 2.4.6 — personal abilities and romance controls, including 2.4.5 body development. New features target RimWorld 1.7; 1.6/Common stay frozen at SSC 2.4.1. Shared ability controls retain original save owners and rules. Stage-based romance preferences, partner selection, one-time orders, mood/history, logs/tasks and personal resets are included. Includes uterine/fertility and stomach development, four-language copy and PNA production guidance. Retains culture, ritual points, cosmetics, bonds, nine PNA weapons, gel appearance, specializations and personality transfer. Mechanisms and Simplified Chinese have batch in-game acceptance; other romance languages have review approval. Three-language display and PNA guidance display remain unconfirmed; balance and unreported mod combinations are not inferred as tested. Replace the whole old folder, retaining version folders/loading configuration. Removed old 1.7 launcher definitions have no save migration. Load Harmony and RJW before SSC; Ideology is required for culture and rituals. Rabbit selection and legacy RimTalk remain unavailable.
